title: Social Media Aggregator Adapter
instructions: Complete `social/adapters.py`. Make `SocialMediaAdapter` an ABC with abstract `get_posts` and `post`, then implement `TwitterAdapter` (client in `twitter_api`) and `FacebookAdapter` (client in `facebook_api`). Convert every platform post into the common `SocialMediaPost`: tweets have no timestamp, Facebook's is copied. Do not edit `services.py` or `model.py`.

evidence.label: SocialMediaAdapter is an ABC with abstract get_posts and post
Adapters hold the platform clients in the named attributes (composition)
Tweets map to SocialMediaPost with timestamp None
Facebook status maps to text and the timestamp is copied
An empty feed returns an empty list
post() delegates to tweet() and post_facebook_status()
Client code treats both platforms uniformly
